name: listing-searchability
description: Diagnoses why a seller's listing isn't found in search and helps make it more discoverable. Checks whether the listing is discoverable at all, then optimizes the content shoppers search on — title, description, bullet points, and generic keywords — with the seller's approval. Triggers on: not showing up in search, can't be found, not discoverable, improve ranking, search visibility, optimize my listing, SEO. Do NOT use for: not-buyable (use listing-buyability) or fixing reported issues (use listing-issues).
